description: Let the agent SEE an image and answer a question about it. Supply the image as `imageUrl` (a public https URL the vision server fetches) OR `image` (raw base64 / a data: URI), and a `prompt` describing what to extract — e.g. "What objects are in this scene?", "Read the text in this screenshot", "Is this avatar render rigged correctly?". Returns the model's answer as `text`, plus the `provider` and `model` that served it (a free NVIDIA NIM lane when available, an automatic paid backstop otherwise — the caller never pays). Analysis only: it does not store or mutate anything. Accepts JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF up to 12 MB; base64 inputs are size-checked before upload.

image.description: The image as raw base64 or a `data:image/...;base64,...` URI. Provide this OR `imageUrl`, not both.

imageType.description: MIME type of a raw base64 `image` (ignored for data URIs / `imageUrl`). Defaults to image/jpeg.

imageUrl.description: Public https URL of the image to analyze. Provide this OR `image`, not both.

maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens in the answer (16–2048). Higher = longer, more detailed reads. Default 512.

prompt.description: The question or instruction about the image (what to extract, read, classify, or critique).

name: analyze_image
title: Analyze an image against a prompt
